source_note: The exact Robin Sport PES manufacturer page rechecked 2026-10-05 explicitly distinguishes the maximum 700×40C frame/fork clearance from fitted Chaoyang COBRA H-496 700×28C tyres, identifies BSA, and provides six geometry sizes. Earlier accepted August evidence and the September refresh timeout remain dated history. The PES electronic 2×12 BOM and HS-EPS+/FLEX AIR frame with HS-HPT fork are exact-build evidence; qualitative stiffness wording has no numeric test protocol. Controlled stock complete-bike weight and current checkout conditions remain unresolved; reseller and modified-owner weights are not promoted. This recheck does not supply Robin EVO specifications or a new price observation.

audit_corrections.reason: The exact PES page explicitly labels maximum clearance separately from fitted tyres and is readable on this recheck; earlier ambiguity and timeout no longer describe the active evidence.
